title: Cleaner desktop updates
summary: Desktop update notes now render as clean, readable summaries instead of exposing GitHub formatting tags.
highlights: Readable feature lists without HTML tags
Safer handling for GitHub Markdown and HTML release notes

title: A faster way into DOIT
summary: Sign in with Google across web and desktop, with clearer update summaries that explain why each release is worth installing.
highlights: Google sign-in and signup across web and desktop
Short, customisable reasons inside every update popup

title: Plans worth sharing
summary: Turn a DOIT goal into a polished social-ready card, and see exactly what changes in every desktop update.
highlights: Shareable Plan Cards for DOIT Pro and MAX
Square, vertical, and landscape PNG exports
Custom desktop update notes and an in-app Version Logs page

title: A clearer Coach lineup
summary: DOIT Coach is now a focused Pro and MAX experience, with MAX adding intelligence across every active goal.

title: The complete DOIT MAX system
summary: MAX now prioritises across goals, forecasts deadlines, detects overload, and proposes reviewable plan rebuilds.

title: Safer billing and smarter planning
summary: The standard planner became more useful and Stripe cancellation events now safely handle deleted accounts.

title: A stronger first five minutes
summary: New users can create a quality goal and complete their first real action faster, with desktop deep links returning to DOIT.

title: DOIT on every Mac
summary: The desktop release now supports both Intel and Apple silicon Macs.

title: Better release reliability
summary: Desktop crash reporting configuration and recovery handling were strengthened.

title: Updates without reinstalling
summary: DOIT Desktop gained automatic update checks, background downloads, and restart-to-install support.

title: Desktop launch fix
summary: Fixed the blank window that could appear when launching the installed desktop app.

title: DOIT AI Desktop arrives
summary: The first dedicated Windows and macOS edition of DOIT AI.
